svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 10 · Santa Cruz · 10/12 Deer at Dawn (Common)
svg.desc: Early morning, deer graze the meadow like they own it. Give them room and they barely look up. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
